capabilities.title: Fresh install, factory bootstrap, enrollment and claim
capabilities.rationale: Legacy removable-media/factory scripts are replaced by exact approved-bundle handoff, preclaim host bootstrap, consuming bound claim and resumable install state.

capabilities.title: Dedicated kiosk, cfadmin, bootstrap-user cleanup and desktop session baseline
capabilities.rationale: V2 creates dedicated clientflow-kiosk and password-enabled sudo cfadmin, persists the temporary bootstrap user until healthy activation and applies a consistent desktop baseline.

capabilities.title: Network readiness, client name/locality and bounded bootstrap-profile cleanup
capabilities.rationale: Legacy factory network preparation is replaced by preclaim NetworkManager/backend readiness, bound name/locality and explicit UUID-owned temporary profile cleanup.

capabilities.title: Display, browser kiosk, calendar and graphical-session behavior
capabilities.rationale: Legacy monolithic display/browser/calendar helpers are decomposed into isolated Display services, brokered power control, browser guard and calendar agent while preserving the accepted user-facing behavior.

capabilities.title: Local GUI, support bundle, recovery and switch-user workflow
capabilities.rationale: GTK4 local GUI preserves legacy functional sections/copy affordances; bounded recovery and switch-user helpers preserve technician support without generic privileged shell access.

capabilities.title: Periodic time integrity, kiosk quick settings and popup baseline
capabilities.rationale: V2 reasserts Europe/Copenhagen/NTP periodically, applies bounded kiosk-only quick settings and installs popup suppression for both human accounts.

capabilities.title: Local power attribution, canonical System commands and OS update
capabilities.rationale: V2 preserves canonical System command authority, adds local reboot/shutdown attribution across boot and keeps Ubuntu update behind a fixed-function System broker.

capabilities.title: Whole-bundle update, rollback and pre-first-activation repair
capabilities.rationale: Legacy self-update scripts are replaced by immutable whole-bundle deployment, separate update identity, transactional activation/rollback and explicit approved no-active repair.

capabilities.title: Status, diagnostics, presence and reconnect
capabilities.rationale: Legacy shared service/status utilities are replaced by the isolated Status agent, normalized diagnostics and explicit presence/reconnect contracts.

capabilities.title: Frozen Livestream functional compatibility
capabilities.rationale: Legacy Livestream behavior is superseded by the already physically proven isolated V2 Livestream domain; this gate is read-only and must not change its runtime.

capabilities.title: Frozen Terminal functional compatibility
capabilities.rationale: Legacy terminal capability is provided by the physically proven isolated standard/root Terminal brokers and domain credentials; gate is read-only.

capabilities.title: Frozen Remote Desktop functional compatibility
capabilities.rationale: Legacy Remote Desktop is provided by the physically proven isolated Wayland capture/input domain; gate is read-only and preserves frozen files.

capabilities.title: Runtime state/config/dependency materialization
capabilities.rationale: Legacy shared mutable JSON defaults and in-payload pip requirements are replaced by isolated domain state/credentials, release-owned locked artifacts and reproducible runtime materialization.
